resume:
AARAV SHAH
Product Analyst | +91 99999 12345 | aarav.shah@example.com | 2001 Bay Street, Tower 20 | LinkedIn | Portfolio

Summary
Product analyst with 4 years of experience across growth, video learning, AI insights, dashboards, SQL, OCR, RAG, LLM analytics, and executive decision systems. I like turning ambiguous product bets into measurable decisions.

Experience
Product Analyst — Northstar Commerce                                                                  Aug 2024 - Present
SQL, BigQuery, Amplitude, Python, Experimentation
- Best evidence: fixed checkout instrumentation for a two-sided commerce funnel by separating payment-start, payment-fail, retry-success, and order-confirmed events; this changed the team's read on checkout conversion from 41% to 36% and prevented a false-positive experiment rollout.
- Increased post-cart conversion from 36% to 43% in a 5-week experiment by moving wallet verification after address confirmation; used device, city, and new-vs-returning strata, with payment-failure rate and cancellation rate as guardrails.
- Wrote the decision memo that stopped a discount experiment despite a +12% conversion lift because gross margin fell 4.6 points and refund rate increased in the same exposed cohort.

Product Analyst — VideoHealth Learning App                                                           Jan 2023 - Jul 2024
SQL, Mixpanel, AppsFlyer, Video, Today tab, AI Coach, dashboards
- Increased video lesson completion by 300% and retention by 75% through Video, Today, and AI Coach launches. Exact denominator changed during the rollout because the team migrated from lesson_started to video_started events.
- Architected the AI recommendation engine for learning paths using LLM, RAG, OCR, embeddings, transformer attention, and Python dashboards; in practice I mainly owned the event tracking, adoption dashboard, and weekly PM readouts.
- Built three dashboards named Video Growth, AI Coach Quality, and Today Engagement from the same event table, but each dashboard used slightly different active-user definitions until I normalized them later.
- Reduced churn from 40% to 10% after improving onboarding, pricing, recommendations, notification timing, and video content quality all in the same quarter.

Associate Product Analyst — VideoHealth Learning App                                                  Jan 2023 - Dec 2023
SQL, AppsFlyer, Google Sheets, Campaign Analytics
- Automated campaign dashboards for video acquisition, AI Coach reactivation, and Today-tab experiments; saved 25 minutes per day, but some campaign names were manually cleaned after export.
- Reported a 22% lift in trial starts from a reactivation campaign; later found the holdout group had more expired cards and older cohorts.

Research Intern — CityVision Lab                                                                       May 2022 - Aug 2022
Python, OpenCV, YOLO, OCR, traffic video, visual analytics
- Processed 500 frames of traffic video with OpenCV and YOLO to compare optical flow, blob tracking, and a manual labeling baseline; wrote a short internal note but did not deploy the model.

Awards and Other
- Best Presenter, University Product Analytics Case Competition, 2021.
- Advisor: Prof. K. Rao. Scholarship recipient. Student council analytics volunteer.
- Skills list: SQL, RAG, LLM, OCR, Video Analytics, AI, Product Sense, Python, BigQuery, Mixpanel, AppsFlyer, Excel.

Education
B.Tech in Computer Science — City Institute of Technology, 2018 - 2022
